title: manifest
description: What one task execution was going to be given, written before its command runs. It therefore holds only what is known beforehand: anything a run learns by finishing is not in here, because the manifest was closed before there was anything to learn.

task.description: The task this execution belongs to.

ordinal.description: This execution's index within the task.

command.description: The command line as executed, after substitution.

variables.description: Every value exposed as a template variable for this execution, whether or not the command used it. A reader sees what the task was given and not only what its command became, which matters where a variable was available and went unused.

selection.description: What the task was offered and what it was kept from seeing. Present for a task that consumes paths.

matched.description: The whole matched list, repeated in every execution of a per-path task, because one path alone loses the context of what the task was offered.
